online co op for twilight princess. 2 to 16 players in one world.

put crests_of_courage.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. a co op tab shows up in the menu bar.
one player presses host and reads out the room, everyone else types it and presses join.

for dusklight 2.0.3. everyone has to update: it only connects to 1.8.0.

this build:
- fixed shield pickup crash
- fixed faron bridge and missing portals
- fixed rock rupees vanishing
- fixed lakebed platforms swinging
- warping, transforming and looking around show for others now
- pausing doesn't break your look for others anymore
- custom clawshots and bottles sync
- older version gets told to update
- shows who already got a check
- bought shop items should sell out for everyone
- randomizer: joiners get the host's seed auto picked
- randomizer: fixed graveyard popup on new seeds
